'''V'tal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] appraiser who was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]. She was an armormech specialist.<ref name="Encounter" />
